description: DB foundation + RBAC catalogue for Phase 8 Exams slice 8.1. Add the nine tenant-owned Prisma models + four enums, the hand-authored a-j migration (RLS + append-only/column-guard triggers + guarded campass_app GRANT refresh + catalogue seed) mirroring the frozen fees-slice2 house style, deploy it, and wire the exams.* permission/audit catalogue into @campusgate/shared, the migration seed spans, and catalogue-sync. Everything else (grading engine, routes, live-DB tests) depends on this FEAT landing and deploying first. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in the other direction (nothing here needs them). Grounded in design.md sections 7, 8, 14, 18 and design-review.md Finding 1 (the authoritative ADMIN RBAC binding) + NIT 2/3.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/phase8-exams-slice1/design.md (sections 7, 8, 14, 18) and design-review.md (Finding 1 + NIT 2/3) and context.json FIRST. Do not re-explore what context.json already states.

Add nine Prisma models + four enums to packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma: Examination, GradingScheme, GradeBand, ExamSchedule, Candidate, Assessment, MarksRecord, MarksRecordHistory, ResultPublication, ResultSnapshot; enums ExaminationType, ExaminationStatus, MarksRecordHistoryChangeType (MARKED, CORRECTED), ResultPublicationStatus (PUBLISHED, SUPERSEDED). Single-PK relations only; each model carries institutionId + institution Institution @relation(...) back-ref + @@unique([id, institutionId]) + @@index([institutionId]) + the section-7.x query indexes. Columns/FK targets/uniques/CHECK intentions per design section 7.2. Put a comment block on each model noting that the composite same-tenant FKs, partial unique, RLS, triggers, and CHECKs are raw SQL in the migration (the FeeStructure/FeeComponent precedent at schema.prisma ~line 2062). Do NOT edit modules.ts or any other existing model.
Run npm run build -w @campusgate/api and confirm prisma generate succeeds and tsc has no new errors.

Hand-author packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261206000000_phase8_exams_slice1/migration.sql in the lettered a-j house style, mirroring 20261129000000_phase7_fees_slice2/migration.sql. Header comment enumerates the 14 frozen dirs it must not touch + the table-class split (design section 7.3). (a) CREATE TYPE the four enums; ResultPublicationStatus carries the inline comment pinning SUPERSEDED as reserved-for-8.2 / never-written-in-8.1 (design-review NIT 3). (b) CREATE TABLE the nine tables (+ PKs; updatedAt NOT NULL only on the six mutable/column-guard tables; the three INSERT-only tables have no updatedAt). (c) (id, institutionId) uniques + business uniques + (institutionId)/query indexes + the raw-SQL partial unique candidates_schedule_seat_unique ON "candidates"("institutionId","examScheduleId","seatNo") WHERE "examScheduleId" IS NOT NULL AND "seatNo" IS NOT NULL + the (institutionId, examId, version) unique on result_publications. (d) tenant-root institutionId -> institutions(id) RESTRICT on all nine. (e) composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId per section 7.2, all ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE. (f) CHECKs per sections 7.2/17. (g) ENABLE+FORCE RLS via a DO $$ block — standard {tenant_isolation_select, tenant_isolation_modify} pair on the SEVEN mutable/column-guard tables (examinations, grading_schemes, grade_bands, exam_schedules, assessments, candidates, marks_records) and {tenant_isolation_select, <table>_tenant_insert} on the THREE INSERT-only tables (marks_record_history, result_publications, result_snapshots), all nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true), '') fail-closed. (h) triggers: examinations_guard() + marks_records_guard() column guards verbatim per design section 8, plus marks_record_history_append_only(), result_publications_append_only(), result_snapshots_append_only() each bound BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ... FOR EACH ROW. (i) guarded idempotent campass_app GRANT refresh (full DML on the seven mutable/guard tables; SELECT,INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE on the three INSERT-only), never BYPASSRLS. (j) the catalogue seed (next step). NEVER edit a frozen dir; NO DROP on existing tables.

Author the exams.* RBAC catalogue in @campusgate/shared: in packages/shared/src/permissions.ts append the eight exams.* PermissionDef rows (module 'examinations') to PERMISSIONS, and edit ROLE_PERMISSIONS — add the SIX keys exams.manage, exams.grading.manage, exams.candidates.manage, exams.moderate, exams.results.publish, exams.results.view to BOTH ADMIN and HOD; add exams.marks.enter to FACULTY; add exams.results.view_own to STUDENT. ADMIN does NOT get exams.marks.enter or exams.results.view_own (design-review Finding 1 — ignore the 'ADMIN gets all eight' phrasing in design section 14.1; the table is authoritative). In packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts append the exams.* audit keys to AUDIT_ACTIONS: exams.examination.created, exams.examination.updated, exams.examination.status_changed, exams.schedule.created, exams.schedule.updated, exams.candidate.registered, exams.candidate.allocated, exams.assessment.created, exams.assessment.updated, exams.marks.entered, exams.marks.corrected, exams.grading_scheme.created, exams.grading_scheme.updated, exams.results.published, exams.results.exported — DROP exams.marks.locked and exams.moderation.opened (design-review NIT 2; those transitions audit under exams.examination.status_changed).

Author section (j) of the migration seed: INSERT INTO "permissions" ("id","key","module","description") VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING with the eight exams.* tuples (shape ('perm_exams_...','exams.key','examinations','desc') so extractPermissionKeys reads the 2nd literal), followed by INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ("id","roleId","permissionId") SELECT 'rp_'||r."key"||'__'||p."key", r."id", p."id" FROM (VALUES (roleKey, permKey), ...) AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN "roles" r ON r."key" = m."roleKey" AND r."institutionId" IS NULL JOIN "permissions" p ON p."key" = m."permKey" ON CONFLICT ("roleId","permissionId") DO NOTHING listing exactly the 14 pairs (ADMIN x6, HOD x6, FACULTY exams.marks.enter, STUDENT exams.results.view_own). The AS m( marker is the catalogue-sync parser end-marker — keep it verbatim. NO new roles row.

Apply the migration from packages/db: run the prisma migrate diff sanity check (confirm the only diffs are the expected composite-vs-single-FK cosmetic ones and NO DROP on any existing table), then npx prisma migrate deploy, then npx prisma migrate status (must report up to date).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build -w @campusgate/api succeeds (prisma generate + tsc) with the nine new client delegates and no new type errors.

npx prisma migrate status (from packages/db) reports the DB up to date including 20261206000000_phase8_exams_slice1; the 14 frozen migration dirs are byte-unchanged and no existing table is dropped or altered destructively.

npm test -w @campusgate/api -- catalogue-sync passes: the union of migration permission keys/pairs equals PERMISSION_KEYS / ROLE_PERMISSIONS (set-equality), with exactly 14 new exams.* role pairs and 8 new keys.
npm test -w @campusgate/api stays green at 454 + any catalogue count deltas (no fast suite regressions).
verification: From packages/db: npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma ; npx prisma migrate deploy ; npx prisma migrate status
